findings.body: When the pin matches the installed version and synced files are clean, doctor prints the version only in its final success line. If another check fails, `rows` is nonempty and doctor refuses before that line (`src/forge/doctor.py:217-219`); this new note is also skipped. For example, a GitHub authentication failure leaves the user with no statement of which Forge version was used for the sync comparison. The new test always creates drift, so it misses this path.
findings.title: Not done: Doctor says which Forge version it compares with

findings.body: If `sync.files` refuses, doctor catches that refusal and sets `wanted = {}` (`src/forge/doctor.py:105-110`), so it performs no synced-file comparison. With a mismatched pin, this new note still says doctor compared the files. A malformed Forge block can trigger that refusal (`src/forge/sync.py:94-100`), making the note falsely imply that the files were checked.
findings.title: Do not say files were compared when sync generation failed
